name: @cockpit/shared-utils
comment: htmlBashSdk is exported as its own subpath because the barrel pulls in paths.ts, which imports node fs/os/path. Browser-only bundles (public/html-lib/*, built by esbuild) resolve every import in the barrel whether or not it is used, so importing the barrel from shared-ui breaks that build outright. Deep-import this subpath from browser-side code.
